tools.description: One lecture on Bettyapp, by its id (lecture.id in a moment) or the address of its page: its course, teacher, Subjects and Levels, credit line, and every moment in it, in order, each with its play_url. tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: A topic (photosynthesis, chain rule, supply and demand): the best moment on Bettyapp that explains it at each Level, from school to university, then a few more and related topics. tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: Every Subject with lectures on Bettyapp, each with its Levels and how many lectures it has, and the Level ladder from Elementary to Graduate & Professional. Use it to find the subject and level values for search_moments, or to tell a student what Bettyapp covers.

tools.description: Find what helps a student with one problem from an assignment, an exam or a textbook page: the moments in Bettyapp's lectures that explain it, a similar practice question and the open textbook's section. tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Bettyapp's university and school lectures for the moments that explain a topic or question. Returns results, best first, each with an id for fetch, a title and the url that opens the lecture at that moment. For a student, search_moments gives more (the summary, teacher and credit line). tools.name: fetch
tools.description: One result of search by its id ("<lecture id>@<second>"), or a lecture by its id or the address of its page: the moment's title, summary, the questions it answers and the teacher's words at its start, its lecture and credit line, and the url that plays from it.

tools.name: find_related_moments
tools.description: Find the moments in Bettyapp's lectures whose meaning is close to the student's question as worded. It helps when the student does not know the topic's name ("why does e to the x stay the same when you differentiate it"). findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "find_for_problem" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: Find what helps a student with one problem from an assignment, an exam or a textbook page: the moments in Bettyapp's lectures that explain it, a similar practic…

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "lookup_textbook_code" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: find_for_problem.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Public sink: find_for_problem

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
